title: Loaded French Pork Brittany Galette
description: A hearty, keto-friendly Brittany-style galette loaded with spicy pork, barbeque sauce, and kombu-cold-extract.

ingredients.name: Barbeque Sauce
ingredients.notes: Make your own or use store-bought

instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground pork, onion, garlic, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands or a spatula until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a large skillet or Dutch oven, and cook over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the meat is browned and cooked through, add the barbeque sauce and kombu-cold-extract. Stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 25cm (10in) round baking dish or skillet, and smooth the top with a spatula.
Drizzle the ghee over the top of the galette, and use a spoon or spatula to spread it evenly.
Transfer the galette to the preheated oven, and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the galette from the oven, and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the galette hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy immediately, as the galette will be quite rich and filling.
